claim: Hiša Franko sits in Staro Selo near Kobarid in the upper Soča Valley.
Kobarid lies between Tolmin (~15 km south) and Bovec (~20 km north) in the Soča Valley.
quote: Tolmin is the biggest settlement and management centre of the Soča Valley… Bovec is the centre of outdoor activities.

claim: Cividale del Friuli (Italy) is about 21–27 km from Kobarid, depending on route.
quote: The distance between Cividale Del Friuli to Kobarid is 21 Kms.

claim: The official Soča Valley events calendar lists no IT, developer, or tech-conference events for 2026.
quote: Calendar shows trail-running festivals, the Tour of Slovenia cycling event, cultural and culinary events; no tech or developer events listed.

claim: PRC Tolmin hosts "Umetna inteligenca za vsak dan" (AI for everyday use) on 9 June 2026.
quote: 9. junij 2026 – Umetna inteligenca za vsak dan.

claim: PRC Tolmin runs a Google Analytics & website-management workshop on 16 June 2026.
quote: 16. junij 2026 – Upravljanje spletnih strani in osnove Google analitike.

claim: PRC's recurring 'podjetniški zajtrk' (entrepreneur breakfast) series runs at Kinogledališče Tolmin; topics rotate through finance, digital marketing, online platforms.
quote: 4. podjetniški zajtrk je potekal v mali dvorani Kinogledališča Tolmin.

claim: Coworking BAZA in central Tolmin offers 12 desks across 90 m² and rents the space for workshops or pop-ups, but no fixed event series is scheduled.
quote: 12 working areas on 90m²… There are no upcoming events at this time.

claim: Hubs Travel's Bovec coliving/workation runs 5 Jan – 15 Apr 2026 (winter season only); from €800/month for a private room with shared kitchen.
quote: Full availability in Winter, from 05.01.2026 to 15.04.2026… €800 / 1st month, €600 / 2nd month, €400 / 3rd month.

claim: The Bovec workation is a community of ~15–20 remote workers with shared dinners, outdoor excursions, and a coworking room; not a conference.
quote: You'll live, work, and connect with remote workers and digital nomads in Bovec… community events and inspiring workation experiences.

claim: PRC ran the first 'Digital Workation in Bovec' in late 2024 — an experimental remote-worker residency, not an annual conference.
quote: Digital nomads will have customized workspaces and a program of activities… As the project is being organized for the first time, the number of participants is limited.

claim: BSides Ljubljana 0x7EA (8th edition) ran 13 March 2026 at Računalniški muzej, Ljubljana — ~110 km from Kobarid, well outside the 30 km radius.
quote: 8th edition of BSides Ljubljana will take place on 13th March 2026 at Računalniški muzej, Celovška cesta 111, Ljubljana.

claim: DragonHack 2026 (Slovenia's largest student hackathon) runs 18–19 April 2026 at FRI in Ljubljana — ~110 km from Kobarid.
quote: DragonHack 2026, Saturday Apr 18 to Sunday Apr 19, Faculty of Computer and Information Science, University of Ljubljana.

claim: POPRI 2026 (national youth-entrepreneurship festival/competition finale) was held 9 April 2026 at Bevkov trg, Nova Gorica — ~60 km from Kobarid, outside the radius.
quote: POPRI festival podjetnosti in podjetništva mladih Slovenije ter zaključna prireditev tekmovanja POPRI 2026… 9. aprila 2026… Bevkov trg, Nova Gorica.

claim: Posoški razvojni center (PRC) in Tolmin coordinates entrepreneurship and digital-skill programmes for the Bovec–Kobarid–Tolmin municipalities.
quote: Posoški razvojni center… koordinacijo socio-ekonomskega razvoja občin Bovec, Kobarid in Tolmin.
